title: Answer a decision input
description: A client answers an Open decision request of a run that waits. An answer to a request that is already answered is refused: the first answer stands. An answer to a withdrawn request (its run was cancelled or ended as orphaned) is refused as DecisionWithdrawn. When the answer stands but the runtime cannot take it up (its run is gone), the daemon writes the run event `runbook.answer-undeliverable` (record: request_id) after the request is Answered (see CancelRun for why it is stated here).

principal.description: The daemon's own principal (runbook serve --principal). The handler fills it from the daemon's configuration; a client never sends it, no HTTP body member or MCP argument sets it, and the HTTP/MCP schema of the client's input has no such member.

answer_offered.description: Whether the request takes the answer: false only for an Open request of the named run, while that run is WaitingOnDecision, that carries an artifact (DecisionArtifact), when the answer is neither the letter of one of its options, alone or followed by a colon and text, nor a free answer of a request that takes one. The handler fills it from the request, because the language cannot read the text of an answer; a client never sends it.

sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.title: AnswererLabel
sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.description: The name a client gives when it answers a decision (the answered_by of AnswerDecision): ASCII text without control characters, at most 200 characters. The daemon trims it of ASCII whitespace and refuses (400) a longer one, one that holds a non-ASCII or a control character, and one whose lower case starts with `rule:`, `decider:` or `router:`, the names it keeps for the answers of a rule, a decider and a router. It is stored and shown trimmed and is never the principal: the principal of an answer is the daemon's own (runbook serve --principal), fixed when the daemon starts, and a label a client types grants nothing.

sdc.daemon.DecisionRequestId.title: DecisionRequestId
sdc.daemon.DecisionRequestId.description: The id of a decision request: the runtime's, copied. A request id that is already taken cannot occur, because the runtime mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.decision.Principal.title: Principal
sdc.decision.Principal.description: Who decides: a person's name (operator), decider:<kind> (decider:model, decider:approve, decider:reject; decider:haiku in runs before D149), or silence for a default taken because nobody answered. Recorded as given, as Canon records a principal (canon-decisions/1).
